identity_cost.detail: no card is required to hold the free plan, and its absence is what triggers suspension rather than a bill: the docs state 'If you haven't added a payment method, Render instead suspends all of your Free services for the remainder of the month'. No hold amount is stated because no payment method is required. The signup form is not quoted, so the email requirement is inferred rather than read; debit and prepaid acceptance are not stated, and a card only changes overage from suspension to billing.

record.notes: The term that binds first for an always-on service: 750 instance hours a month is 31.25 days, so a single always-on free web service uses the whole workspace pool and a second free service has none. Render's free tier also has two traps a reader should know before planning: a free Postgres expires after 30 days, and free services spin down after 15 minutes of inactivity with about a minute to restart. The page states both a 5 GB Hobby egress allowance and a per-GB price beyond it.
